name: EURECA
full_name: European Underground Rare Event Calorimeter Array
summary: EURECA was a historical large-scale multitarget calorimeter proposal combining cryogenic experience from CRESST and EDELWEISS. Its design is archived; an old project website remaining online does not establish current construction.
detection_principle: Different targets would share a large cryogenic system, using heat/light or heat/ionization to identify nuclear recoils. Responses in multiple elements would cross-check dark-matter interpretations.

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The 2014 conceptual design report establishes the proposal; evidence of a completed, independent full experiment has not been obtained.

collaboration.name: EURECA Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Only verified representative institutions are listed, not a complete membership roster. See the collaboration pages and author affiliations in the references.

key_parameters.name: Early two-stage concept
key_parameters.value: Initial 150 kg followed by tonne-scale expansion, in the historical design

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
